headlines.title: Trump orders signage warning visitors of ‘inaccurate information’ at Smithsonian
headlines.description: While he continues to seek control of the exhibits inside the Smithsonian Institution’s museums, President Donald Trump is trying a new tactic in the front yard.

headlines.title: Trump administration concedes that it canceled research grants in blue states
headlines.description: The Trump administration admitted that it terminated nearly 300 federal research grants “solely because” the projects were connected to states that voted against Trump in 2024

headlines.title: Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer backs Haley Stevens in contested Democratic Senate primary

headlines.title: White House Correspondents’ Association president says ‘we will not be intimidated’ during dinner
headlines.description: Weijia Jiang, president of the White House Correspondents’ Association welcomed President Trump, members of the Cabinet, and journalists to the rescheduled dinner, calling it a moment of unity after the attempted shooting at the April event.

headlines.title: South Carolina to hold first Democratic 2028 primary, indicating DNC's push to court minority voters
headlines.description: NBC National Political Reporter Ben Kamisar reports on the DNC rules committee's move to make South Carolina the first state to vote in the 2028 Democratic presidential primary, replacing two heavily white states at the top of the calendar with states with more diverse populations.

headlines.title: James Talarico unveils border policy plan for TX Senate bid, saying 'both parties have failed us'
headlines.description: NBC News Correspondent Ryan Chandler joins State Rep. James Talarico (D-Texas) on a campaign trip to his state's border districts, where he hopes to win over voters with his new border security plan.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: DNC committee sets up South Carolina to vote first in Democrats’ 2028 presidential primaries
headlines.description: South Carolina is poised to hold the first Democratic presidential nominating contest in 2028 after the Democratic National Committee’s powerful rules committee voted to keep the state at the front of the line.

headlines.title: Democrats reshape their primary calendar: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Ben Kamisar breaks down Democrats’ new presidential primary order. Plus, Kristen Welker explores the political pressure the ongoing Iran war is putting on Republicans.

headlines.title: Trump to deliver ‘unifying yet vicious’ remarks at Correspondents’ dinner, White House says
headlines.description: The White House Correspondents’ Association Dinner with President Donald Trump that was disrupted earlier this year when a gunman charged past Secret Service agents is scheduled to be reheld in a different, smaller and more secure venue Friday night.

headlines.title: Fresh wave of U.S. tariffs takes effect, hitting global trade partners
headlines.description: These new duties, which range from 10% to 12.5%, will take effect Friday morning, just as the previous tariffs expire.

headlines.title: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul explains why she signed the first statewide moratorium on data centers
headlines.description: Speaking with NBC News’ “Here’s the Scoop,” Hochul said that she’s responding to the concerns of localities and that New York doesn’t need data centers to support the AI boom.
